priorFix01P2.title: Validate all cached archives before downloading
priorFix01P2.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate all cached archives before downloading**

When a later cached archive is corrupt while an earlier archive is absent, this single loop downloads the earlier archive before reaching and rejecting the corrupt cached file; for example, a bad cached YamlDotNet tarball is checked only after every missing package GET. That violates the FIX01 contract's input-verification-before-download sequence and causes network and write side effects for an input set that was already invalid. Preflight every present `official-get` archive before starting the first GET.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
